<spacer height="10"/> <hgroup> <button id="butSvn" caption="Load from QA SubVersion" onclick="zenPage.loadSettingsFile('SVN');" title="Load SubVersion file to temp directory" width="35"/> <spacer width="20"/>
<button id="butServer" caption="Load from Ensemble" onclick="zenPage.loadSettingsFile('Ensemble');" title="Get Runtime Ensemble file to temp directory" /> <spacer width="20"/> <button id="butEnsSvnDiff" caption="Diff Ensemble/SVN" onclick="zenPage.loadSettingsFile('DiffES');" title="Diff SubVersion vs Ensemble"/> <spacer width="20"/> <button id="butTwoSvnDiff" caption="Diff Environments" onclick="zenPage.loadSettingsFile('DiffSvn');" title="Diff between two different environments in SVN" hidden="true"/>

<hgroup> <spacer width="20"/> <dynaGrid id="dynaGrid" gridLabel="Setting Type" OnCreateDataSet="CreateDataSet" oneditcell="return zenPage.cellEdit(zenThis);" onclickcolumn="return zenPage.columnClick(column);" ondrawcell="return zenPage.calcCellDraw(zenThis,data);" onclickrow="return zenPage.rowClick(row);" rowLabelWidth="200" height="500" scrollIntoView="true" nowrap="false"

<spacer height="20"/>
<vgroup> <text label="CheckIn Comment:" id="CheckInComment" name="CheckInComment" hidden="true" size="50"/> <spacer width="10"/> <button id="butUrl" caption="Go to QA Src Ctrl Tool" onclick="zenPage.GotoURL();" title="Go to Src Tool" width="35" hidden="true"/>
<spacer height="10"/>
<hgroup> <button id="butSave" caption="Save to Server" onclick="zenPage.saveGrid();" title="Save modified Grid to temp directory" hidden="true" /> <spacer width="20"/> <button id="buttonCheckIn" caption="Check In" hidden="true" onclick="zenPage.CheckInSettings();" title="Checkin the saved setting file from temp directory" /> </hgroup> </vgroup>
<spacer height="20"/> <label id="lblAccess" value="" />
</fieldSet>

Method.Description: Server-side callback to provide data for the dynaGrid.
Method.Implementation:
Do pDataSet.%Clear()
#; fill in contents of dataSet #; This is a 2-D data structure
#; row labels (dimension 1) Do pDataSet.%SetLabel("Static",1,1) Do pDataSet.%SetLabel("Host",2,1) Do pDataSet.%SetLabel("Adapter",3,1)
#; column labels (dimension 2) Do pDataSet.%SetLabel("Key",1,2) Do pDataSet.%SetLabel("Value",2,2)
#; find size of dataSet Set rows = pDataSet.%GetDimSize(1) Set cols = pDataSet.%GetDimSize(2)
Do pDataSet.%SetValue("File",1,1) Do pDataSet.%SetValue("Not Selected",1,2) Quit $$$OK
